# speech-synthesis

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: The browser's speech synthesis (Web Speech API), only where it exists: speechSupport(win?) answers unsupported (some Android browsers, in-app webviews and privacy-hardened builds have no speechSynthesis) or supported with speak(text, options) and cancel() — so a caller must branch before it can speak, and goes silent where the browser cannot talk. Its lint rule (no-raw-speech-synthesis) sends every other speechSynthesis / SpeechSynthesisUtterance use here.
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by: `apps/keyboard-party/party`
- Web:
  - Exports (types):
    - `SpeakOptions`
    - `SpeechSupport`
  - Exports (values): `speechSupport`
